verdict.rationale: Aider has no JetBrains plugin. Its only IDE-adjacent feature is `--watch-files` mode: you can work in 'your favorite IDE or text editor' and add #AI / AI! / AI? comments to a file, which adds it to the chat and triggers edits. This is a generic, comment-driven workaround rather than native in-IDE integration, and the IDE is never named as JetBrains. Missing for 10: a JetBrains IDE plugin or integration, interactive diff viewing inside the IDE, sharing selected code snippets as context, and any hands-on corroboration of use in JetBrains.
